newsitem.title: USA: SECURITY FIRST UNIT GETS DEVELOPMENT FUNDING.
newsitem.headline: SECURITY FIRST UNIT GETS DEVELOPMENT FUNDING.

text.p: Security First Technologies, a unit of Security First Network Bank, said it received $14.2 million in development funding that fulfills a "significant" portion of its anticipated cash flow requirements for 1998.
Shares of Security First gained 2-1/8 to 11-1/8.
Security First Technologies (S1) said it entered into technology licensing agreements with Barnett Banks Inc, Citicorp, Principal Financial Group and Synovus Financial Corp.

The pact allows those companies to have licensed use of the S1 Internet banking solution, Virtual Financial Manager. The firms will also have the right to participate in the development and direction of S1 products, through representation on the S1 board of directors, S1 said.

In addition to the license agreements, affiliates of Barnett, Citicorp, Principal, and Synovus, as well as Huntington Bancshares Inc and Wachovia Corp, which are currently represented on the S1 Board, each purchased about $1.0 million of stock in Security First Network Bank.
The private placement stock transaction resulted in the issuance of 569,978 shares of common stock and 159,952 shares of preferred stock, Security First said.
